description_en: Queries the details of all installed components in a cluster by cluster ID
description_zh: 根据集群ID，查询集群中已安装的所有组件的详情
name: DescribeClusterAddonsVersion

can_upgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the component can be upgraded. Valid values:

`true`: The component can be upgraded.
`false`: The component cannot be upgraded
can_upgrade.description_zh:
组件是否可升级。取值：

`true`：组件可升级。
`false`：组件不可升级

changed.description_en:
Indicates whether the component has been updated. Valid values:

`true`: The component has been updated.
`false`: The component has not been updated
changed.description_zh:
组件是否有更新。取值：

`true`：已更新。
`false`：未更新

exist.description_en:
Indicates whether the component can be installed in the cluster. Valid values:

`true`: The component can be installed.
`false`: The component cannot be installed
exist.description_zh:
是否可以在集群中安装该组件。取值：

`true`：可安装。
`false`：不可安装

message.description_en: The additional description of whether the component can be upgraded
message.description_zh: 组件是否可升级的额外说明
message.example: 节点故障检测以及上报至事件中心的插件

next_version.description_en: The next version to which the component can be upgraded

policy.description_en:
The component upgrade policy.

`overwrite`: forcible overwrite.

Default value: `overwrite`
policy.description_zh:
组件升级策略。

`overwrite`：强制覆盖。

默认值：`overwrite`

ready_to_upgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the component meets the upgrade conditions. Valid values:

`true`: The component meets the upgrade conditions.
`false`: The component does not meet the upgrade conditions
ready_to_upgrade.description_zh:
组件是否满足升级条件。取值：

`true`：满足升级条件。
`false`：不满足升级条件
ready_to_upgrade.title_en: 组件是否满足升级条件
ready_to_upgrade.title_zh: 组件是否满足升级条件

required.description_en:
Indicates whether the component is required by the cluster. Valid values:

`true`: The component is required.
`false`: The component is not required
required.description_zh:
组件是否为集群必需组件。取值：

`true`：为必需组件。
`false`：非必需组件

value.description_en: The custom parameter values specified when installing the component
value.description_zh: 组件安装时，用户自定义的参数值
value.example: npd:\n  # Custom monitor definitions to add to Node Problem Detector ****
value.title_en: 安装addon的时候，用户自定义的参数值。Yaml字符串。
value.title_zh: 安装addon的时候，用户自定义的参数值。Yaml字符串。

version.description_en:
The current version of the component.

If the value of `version` is not empty, the component is installed
version.description_zh:
组件当前版本。

如果`version`值不为空，则表示该组件已经安装
